freejia_tilefx_3FE0: Animation 0: groups 14C028, 14C03C, 14C050, 14C064 (tile bytes 0 to 3), each held 7 (8 ticks); the hidden $FFFF terminator wraps the loop. Streamed to VRAM word $3FE0.
freejia_tilefx_3FF0: Animation 1: groups 14C078, 14C08C, 14C0A0, 14C0B4 (tile bytes 4 to 7), each held 6 (7 ticks). Streamed to VRAM word $3FF0.
snake_pit_fx_frame_0: Frame 0: tile byte $00 = the first 128 bytes of misc_fx_1CD380. snake_pit_fx_frame_1, snake_pit_fx_frame_2 and snake_pit_fx_frame_3 differ only by the tile byte ($04, $08, $0C).
spm_overworld_sprites: Animation table (14 entries). The index is the party-array word WorldMapController writes to actor field $28: #00-#06 single figures, #07-#0A four pieces of one multi-part sprite, #0B-#0D scripted-trip leaders.
sprite_group_148544: Example group: Shadow idle south, the only frame of animation $00. Header: extents X 16 / 16, Y 45 / 8, default attack and body boxes, 6 sub-sprites of 16x16 (tile words $0000, $0020, $0102, $0100, $0022, $000E; $0102 and $0100 use the second name table, bit 8).
sprite_group_adrift_wave_0: Frame 0: one sprite-part, word $0A00 (art offset 0 in the streamed source).
sprite_group_adrift_wave_1: Frame 1: one sprite-part, word $0A04 (art offset 4 tiles = 128 bytes).
sprite_group_adrift_wave_2: Frame 2: one sprite-part, word $0A08 (art offset 8 tiles = 256 bytes).
sprite_group_adrift_wave_3: Frame 3: one sprite-part, word $0A0C (art offset 12 tiles = 384 bytes).
sprite_set_adrift_wave_loop: Animation 0, four frames of 8 ticks each (hold word $0007), looping through sprite_group_adrift_wave_0, sprite_group_adrift_wave_1, sprite_group_adrift_wave_2 and sprite_group_adrift_wave_3.
sprite_set_snake_pit_fx_loop: Frame list of animation 0: groups snake_pit_fx_frame_0, snake_pit_fx_frame_1, snake_pit_fx_frame_2, snake_pit_fx_frame_3, snake_pit_fx_frame_2, snake_pit_fx_frame_1, each held 5 (6 ticks). The hidden $FFFF terminator after the last record wraps the loop (AdvanceSpriteAnim clears the frame counter at it). 36 ticks per cycle.
spriteset_adrift_wave: Animation-index table: one entry, animation 0 = sprite_set_adrift_wave_loop. dc2F_adrift_fx starts it with SetTileStreamAnim ( #00, #$2010 ): animation index 0, VRAM word address $2010.
spriteset_freejia_tilefx: Two animation pointers (index 0 and 1), selected by the first operand of SetTileStreamAnim in fr32_laborer_npc.
spriteset_shadow: 76 word pointers to frame lists, indexed by the actor animation index ($28); the same index space as spriteset_freedan (see its table part note for the staged indices). The Shadow shapes are listed in the block note: idle 1 frame (hold 9), walk 6 frames (hold 7), melee 7 frames, guard 8 frames of hold 0; the ledge-jump fall cycle and the ladder idles are single frames.
spriteset_snake_pit_fx: Animation table with a single entry (index 0), used by awB4_snake_pit_fx. Any other animation index would read past the table.
